turns.text: Yes, we are almost on the finish line of this training. The first phone call, you're asking him a question to make him feel that whatever he knows now about the real estate market is not enough for him to be able to trust his own judgment and make decision on his own. Oh, have you been to Dubai? Okay, and and was that more like a leisure trip or more like an investment driven that you've been looking into some areas and options from the professional perspective. How confident do you feel yourself in terms of being able to make a decision on which area is the best for your investment?
